title: Jamaican Feta Casserole
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make casserole that combines the spicy flavors of Jamaica with the tanginess of feta cheese. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Grease the casserole base with olive oil.
In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion and bell pepper until softened.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the jamaican hot sauce and cook for another minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked onion mixture, feta cheese, and chicken broth.
Pour the mixture into the greased casserole base.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
